purpose: Teach: 結びつく/オーディション/去り/今季/真意/一読/一概に/トレーナー

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: マーケティングと製造、しっかり、結びつくよう、調整、お願いね。
lines.en: I need Marketing and Manufacturing to coordinate more carefully. Could you handle that?
lines.style: Businesslike, efficient. Clear-eyed focus. Speaking downward slightly — not harsh, just matter-of-fact. Expects competent execution without fuss.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人広報、オーディション形式で、選考いたしました、最終候補、絞れました。
lines.en: Yes. We've run the new PR hire through an audition process and narrowed it down to final candidates.
lines.style: Steady, capable. Reporting facts in sequence. Even pace, slightly formal register to show respect for the decision-making process. Reliable delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 同期の山田さん、会社を、去り、独立されるそうよ、寂しいわね。
lines.en: Yamada from our cohort is leaving the company to start her own thing. It's going to feel strange without her.
lines.style: A beat of genuine wistfulness on the opening. Softer register than the directive. Trailing-off slightly — the real feeling underneath the professional moment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今季の販促キャンペーン、効果、出ております、皆様のおかげで。
lines.en: Yes. The promotional campaign this quarter is showing real results. That's thanks to all of you.
lines.style: Warm recognition settling into the words. Not effusive — this is real gratitude, not performance. Measured but genuine. A small nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様の真意、メールだけじゃ、伝わらないわよね、対面で、聞きましょう。
lines.en: You can't really understand what a customer truly needs through email alone. We should meet with them face-to-face.
lines.style: Conversational, but with quiet conviction. Not lecturing — speaking from lived experience. Emphasis lands lightly on 'face-to-face' as the real solution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。配布資料、皆様、一読、お願いいたします、本日の会議前に。
lines.en: Yes. Please have everyone read through the distributed materials before today's meeting.
lines.style: Polite but clear expectation. Formal register appropriate to a group directive. Not rushed, but purposeful — the tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界状況、一概には、評価できないわよね、各社、強み、違うから。
lines.en: You can't really evaluate the industry landscape with a single brush stroke. Every company has different strengths.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. A slight reflective pause before speaking. Teaching tone — not condescending, but helping him think it through. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員向け、トレーナー、定期的に、お招きしております、新人研修で。
lines.en: Yes. We bring in external trainers regularly for the new hire onboarding programs.
lines.style: Steady, informative. Report-like, but with understated warmth — showing investment in the development process. Even rhythm, professional warmth.
